about_the_game:
Meet February, the magical, forgetful and slightly bonkers explorer who you will play as. She finds herself in a world with only one thing to do: keep running!

This combat-free, rogue-like side scroller focuses on speed and character movement. As February, you'll explore a variety of worlds, each with their unique mechanics. Collect resources to create more complex worlds to explore in the hope of figuring out what happened.

  • Race against the clock to explore procedurally generated worlds!

  • Collect resources and use them to create more complex worlds. The choices you make will determine how the next world is generated.

  • Discover hidden paths and information to piece together the truth!

  • Customise movement controls, but beware of the challenges this will create in the next world!

  • Unlock handicaps! After the revelation, test your skills in new modes with increasing difficulty!

Note: the art found on this page and in screenshots is not final. All artwork and screenshots are subject to change before release.
